limitations: The four TG residue percentages and all eight LOIs are printed numerical annotations in Figure 3; no curve or bar height is digitized. Residue temperature is left blank because the annotations have no temperature label, while the separate method endpoint is 800 °C. The 50% carbon-fabric/50% epoxy control is different from the additive-free glass-veil laminate C-N0-D0 (34% carbon fabric, 50% epoxy, 16% glass veil). Section 3.2 calls C-N0-D0 a control and abbreviates the 53.2% residue as C, but the Figure 3a legend explicitly assigns that trace to C-N0-D0; it is not assigned to the unskinned control. Section 3.2 calls 31.6% the peak LOI, whereas Figure 3b, the abstract and conclusion identify C-N3-D2 at 32.3%; the printed state-specific labels are preserved with this ranking conflict disclosed. C-N3-D2 itself has no numeric TG and is excluded. For treated laminates, Table 1 lists 34% carbon fiber, 50% epoxy, 10% glass fiber and 5% total flame retardant, totaling 99%; the missing fraction is not assigned to PEO or renormalized. Carbon-fabric ply count and weave, epoxy hardener identity and ratio, drying duration, TG sample mass, pan, aliquot cutting and skin/core selection, and LOI conditioning, replication and uncertainty are unreported. Only one preparation sequence and one set of nominal composite formulations is specified; no alternate ply architecture or precursor TG is substituted. Related polyurethane-treated glass-veil papers have only abstract-level accessible evidence, so exact cross-paper control equivalence remains unverified and later reuse requires original state-level comparison. No durability-washed state, cone residue or thermal-stage range is used as a TG point.
sample_state: C-N0-D0; glass-veil-skinned carbon-fabric/epoxy laminate; initial state
composition: Table 1 native formulation: carbon fiber 34.0 wt%, epoxy 50.0 wt%, glass fiber 16 wt%, Ni(OH)2 0 wt%, DOPO 0 wt%. Total is 100 wt%.
treatment_method: A glass-fiber slurry was prepared from 1 g PEO in 500 mL deionized water with 2 g glass fibers, dissociated for 15 min, then formed by extraction and filtration into a 0.1 mm mat. Flame-retardant particles were sprayed onto the undried mat according to the source formulation, followed by plate drying at 60 °C; no flame retardant is assigned to C-N0-D0. Pre-cut carbon-fiber fabrics were stacked as the core and covered with the corresponding glass-fiber veils, introduced into LY1572 epoxy resin, then hot-pressed and cured at 80 °C for 1 h under 2 bar. Ply count, hardener recipe and veil drying duration are not reported.
source_residue_entry_raw: Figure 3a printed 53.2%; no explicit residue temperature
pairing_evidence: Figure 3a explicitly labels the TG trace C-N0-D0 and prints its residue 53.2%. Figure 3b labels the corresponding composite bar C-N0-D0 with LOI 22.6%. Table 1 and section 2.4 define that prepared laminate; section 2.6 reports its own TG and oxygen-concentration combustion methods. Unreinforced resin, isolated veils and the unskinned control are not substituted.
